camera.author: phatcorns
camera.title: Camera Shutter
camera.description: Canon T3i recording; one shutter excerpt from CC0 preview, filtered and softened
camera.user_revision: Requested crisper shutter after initial soft preview; 4.8 kHz cutoff and intact natural transients. Door derivatives unchanged.

doors.source: Existing CC0 door_open.wav / door_close.wav; originals retained

opening_replacement.author: Pfannkuchn
opening_replacement.title: Wooden door 1, opening and closing with different speeds and articulations
opening_replacement.description: First opening of an old wooden kitchen door; original first opening excerpt, soft latch transient. Replaces opening only; closing retained.

processing: Mono 32 kHz PCM16; see per-output processing. Camera retains natural transients, 4.8 kHz low-pass, peak 0.55; doors retain 1.8 kHz low-pass, smooth tanh transient shaping, 6 ms attack/up to 70 ms fade-out and peak 0.4. No originals modified. Opening subsequently replaced with a wooden-kitchen-door recording: see opening_replacement and per-output values.

outputs.transient_processing: No compression; preserve recorded attack; 2 ms opening and 60 ms closing fade
